originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: Boij et al. 1302.5742 decides only predecessor cell (1,3,6,6,3,1) and reduces codim-3 WLP to compressed odd socle; Boij et al. 2406.17943 proves WLP only for Sperner<=d+1 and explicitly leaves open socle+Sperner both >6 — target cell d=7 Sperner=10 lies in stated open region. Maeno-Watanabe 0903.3581 gives higher-Hessian criterion without socle-7 evaluation. Gondim 1506.06387 constructs SLP/WLP failures only in codim>=4 (N+1>=4), excluding codim-3 cell. Altafi 2007.10684 gives SI-sequence existence/SLP families, not this cell decision. Altafi et al. 2502.18149 proves SLP only for binomial dual generators; F0 is tetranomial, different class. Live arXiv API query for exact HF "1,3,6,10,10,6,3,1" returns 0 hits (re-checked). No prior records factored Hess2, rank/Jordan, or mu/Betti row for F0 or any (1,3,6,10,10,6,3,1) dual septic. Result is not mechanically implied by criteria/existence theorems or socle-5 decision.
